Description:

The Paramilitary 2 is really the most popular flagship of the Spyderco line.  Every knife collector should have one...or even two.  The thin profile fits easily in the pocket and the four position clip allows you to customize the way you want it.  The ergonomics are comfortable and the trademark spydie hole makes for quick opening.  The bushing pivot system makes sure that that opening action is as smooth as butter.  The top compression lock is on the spine and ensures that the blade stays in place when in use.   The blade is a full flat grind and is superior slicer.

If you have never had a Paramilitary 2, you deserve to try one.

This Paramilitary 2 has the black G10 scales and a Satin CPM-S45VN Blade.

products.body:
Description:

More than 25 years after its original release, the eagerly anticipated Military 2 builds on that hard-earned reputation while incorporating several significant design improvements. Instead of a LinerLock, the Military 2’s full-flatground f CPM -S30V blade is supported by Spyderco’s signature Compression Lock mechanism, which offers greater strength and even safer one-handed operation. The stainless steel liners that form the foundation of the lock are larger, giving the knife increased structural strength and anchoring its four-position pocket clip, which is configurable for left or right-side, tip-up or tip-down carry. The skeletonized liners are nested within peel-ply-textured G-10 scales to maintain a slim profile and complement its open-backed construction to reduce the knife’s overall weight. A proud successor to a legendary design, the Military 2 is ready to serve.

Description:

Spyderco’s Chaparral series is a testament to the diverse range of handle materials and treatments that can be expertly crafted within a classic gentlemen’s folder design. The latest addition to this distinguished collection features scales made from striking FatCarbon Red Carbon Fiber. This eye-catching composite is crafted from recycled carbon fiber and epoxy resin, resulting in an incredibly strong, lightweight, and chemical-resistant material that is as beautiful as it is complex. The captivating scales of this knife elevate the Chaparral’s renowned design, which includes a full-flat-ground CTS-XHP stainless steel blade, a Trademark Round Hole for easy ambidextrous one-handed opening, a reliable back lock mechanism, and a deep-pocket wire clip that is reversible for left or right-side tip-up carry. The Chaparral Red FatCarbon not only exudes class but also delivers exceptional performance for any occasion.

Description:

Kevin Smock is an award-winning industrial designer who is turning heads with his visionary handcrafted custom knives. Based on his SK23 custom folder, the Spyderco Smock translates his innovative style into a premium-quality production folder.

The hollow-ground blade of this knife is precision machined from CPM® S30V® stainless steel and includes both a Trademark Round Hole™ and an elegantly understated flipper opener. The flipper action is supported by a pair of special ball-bearing pivot washers and a dedicated secondary detent mechanism separate from the knife's lock. It is paired with a skeletonized handle featuring full stainless steel liners, textured carbon fiber/G-10 laminate scales, lightweight, open-backed construction, and a reversible, tip-up pocket clip for ambidextrous carry.
